answer: A Registered domain bound by one-time code delivery with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. Auditors look for the timber that does not belong: a channel with no owner behind it. A willow alone is noise; a wharf of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
